code_prompt_defaults.object_description_tic_tac_toe_3d: three stacked 3 by 3 layers of a 3D Tic-Tac-Toe board, ordered from top to bottom
code_prompt_defaults.tic_tac_toe_3d_winning_rule_text: A line can run within one layer, straight through the layers, diagonally across a face, or diagonally through all three layers.
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_x_winning_move_label: set "annotation" to an array containing [x0, y0, x1, y1] boxes for the selected empty-cell option and the two X cells that support the winning line
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_x_winning_move_label: set "answer" to only the selected option letter
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_o_winning_move_label: set "annotation" to an array containing [x0, y0, x1, y1] boxes for the selected empty-cell option and the two O cells that support the winning line
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_o_winning_move_label: set "answer" to only the selected option letter
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_x_piece_count_in_layer: set "annotation" to an array containing pixel-coordinate [x, y] points at the centers of all X pieces in the requested layer
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_x_piece_count_in_layer: set "answer" to the number of X pieces in the requested layer
